content:
Maya Chen: Quick design Q — we need to pick between a compact CTA hero in the empty-project state vs a persistent right-hand sidebar walkthrough for first-run. Which drives higher sample-project completion? Attached mock: https://figma.com/s/xyz :thinking:

Samir Patel: my hot take: compact hero is less noisy and better for small screens. sidebar feels heavier but gives discoverability for long guides.

Oliver Reed: Agree with Samir on mobile. Also worried about keyboard focus if we implement a sidebar that slides in — need to avoid focus traps.

Priya Singh: From analytics, about 38% start sample flow from the hero CTA today, but completion drops to 12% at step 2. We should optimize for lowering that dropoff before adding extra chrome.

Maya Chen: Good data. Do we have microcopy variants? Button text options: `Try sample app`, `Create demo project`, `Start with sample` — which is clearest?

Keisha Tan: I prefer "Start with sample" — explicit and action-oriented. But A/B test `Create demo project` too, since some users expect "create" = persists resources.

Samir Patel: UX/accessibility nit: hero CTA needs a proper aria-live announcement and clear focus order. If we animate entrance, make sure reduced-motion respected.

Oliver Reed: For the sidebar idea: propose a compressed mode — show 2-step CTA (1. scaffold, 2. run) and expand only on click. Keeps discoverability without hogging real estate.

Priya Singh: Proposed A/B plan: cohort A = compact hero CTA (variant A1 with "Start with sample"), cohort B = compressed sidebar (two-step preview), measure: sample-creation rate, time-to-first-api-call, and 7-day retention of created project. Run for 2 weeks, need ~2k impressions per arm.

Maya Chen: Sounds good. Can we add an accessibility checklist to the PR? Items: keyboard nav, screenreader labels, reduced-motion, contrast ratios, tab order.

Evan (DesignBot): Accessibility checklist template: 
```
- Focus order reviewed
- ARIA labels added for primary CTA
- Reduced motion respected
- Color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text
- Keyboard operable flows tested
```

Keisha Tan: Also add a telemetry event: `onboard.sample.started` and `onboard.sample.completed` + step index. Helps pinpoint dropoffs.

Samir Patel: Mock tweak suggestion: change hero copy to two-line: heading "Try a sample project" + subtext "Get up and running in under 2 minutes". Keeps hero lightweight but communicates value.

Maya Chen: OK next steps: Samir + Oliver to prototype compressed-sidebar variant (mobile + desktop). Priya to wire up metric events. Keisha to own A/B test launch. I'll collect final copy options and post a quick poll.

Priya Singh: Also flag for localization: make sure CTA short copy fits in DE/FR/JP locales.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — will post updated mocks by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
